story: Silver amulet is the oldest evidence of Christianity north of the Alps
text: My favorite find in the last few months is the youtube channel "esoterica" - here's his video on the origins of yaweh as a storm god [VIDEO] He recommends books and primary sources for every episode and they vary from interesting more pubscience type stuff to incredibly expensive and deep academic sources out of print. The gentleman who runs it is very obviously jewish in practice but only uses that to inform his historical context instead of override it, its very refreshing as someone who is an atheist.
